task: P2-5 task P5.4 (ADR 0023 §23.2 decision 6; docs/reports/rl_ready/P2_REMAINING_PLAN.md §3, table P5.1-P5.6)

labels.statement: Synthetic numerical validation of the calibration interface. The truth is the simulator itself (same model family) at a finer resolution with sensor noise. It is NEVER a calibration: no real rubber data exists on this machine; no recipe is promoted; synthetic manifests can never satisfy the REAL_CALIBRATED gate. Same-family truth cannot reveal model-form error against real rubber; it tests identifiability, the pipeline and generalisation of the declared protocol under discretisation and noise.
labels.resolution_specific: Q1w (K2 review condition 4): every fitted theta is RESOLUTION_SPECIFIC to rubber_ref_v1 (n_t 4, CFL 0.5), which carries the measured wide-strip sag bias Q1w +0.62 % (+0.50 ... +0.78 %; known_limitation rubber_phys_11_v5_q1w_gci_2.16pct). The n_t 6 truth is itself +0.21 % for Q1w, so the discretisation floor b_mk captures only about 0.4 % of the n_t 4 bias, not the whole bias. theta_hat is never carried to n_t 3 or 6 without the bias shift; the fit receipt carries the label.
labels.sealing: The seal is procedural (K2 review, P2-5 additions): the truth is generated and revealed by separate processes; sealed/ lives under artifacts/ (outside the git worktree, on /mnt/data) with mode 0700 / 0400; every read through rubber_calibration_synthetic.reveal is logged in sealed/read_log.txt; the fit / held-out API refuses sealed paths. The fitting agent runs as the same OS user, so CAL-08 detects order violations, not peeking.

code.code_commit: 9b138a9 (P5.1-P5.3) + 221c337 (lockstep starts, material dedup, rebound direction, translational check, resolution label, sealed read log); a change to the semantics of a module after this declaration is a protocol v2
code.unchanged: rubber_calibration.py (v1) and the REAL_CALIBRATED block of rubber_material.parse_recipe (byte pins in tests/test_rubber_calibration_v2.py)

common.model: neo_hookean_jbar_prony_v1, M = 2 Prony terms on the isochoric part

step_material.note: mu0_max = mu_eq,max / (1 - G) of the parameter space (4e5 / 0.5); dt from the step rule at the fidelity's CFL; identical for every candidate so that the objective is smooth in theta

common.contact_law_parameters: ContactSpec defaults (kappa_n 0.25, kappa_t 0.25, zeta_n 0.5, zeta_t 0.5, zeta_d 1.0) = rubber_contact_tests_v3 common.law_parameters
common.contact_envelope: ENV1 / ENV2 (claude/rl-rubber-p26): contact_envelope_v2 sha256 46f74efa880cf7121e50070a0cf5fb2358e87d7e390f67cd7b608802f9f03b78 (commit dc35bda): law v3 ESTABLISHED sliding / static mu_max 0.8 at n_t 4 (contact_v3_001) and n_t 6 (contact_envelope_v1_001); the fit box mu_table [0.3, 0.8] and the prior box [0.4, 0.6] lie inside both rows (translational scope, K2-1). Law v3 status EXPERIMENTAL_NOT_ACCEPTED until the K2 review (labelled).
common.gravity: solver gravity 0; the body weight M_g g (strip-local -z, g 9.81) is applied as a traction per traction group (particle mass of the model, i.e. the measured density for the fit model, rho* for the truth), ramped with smootherstep so that the loads are quasi-static; its work is part of the traction work
common.applied_loads: tip load, push and top load are absolute inputs in N (multiples of the NOMINAL weight rho_nom 1150 kg/m^3 x V_nominal x g where stated), independent of the model's density
common.geometry: every specimen on the particle lattice of both fidelities (spacing dx / 2); the forward model uses the nominal lattice geometry; measured dimensions and mass enter only the density
common.devices: CAL-01 / CAL-02 on the Warp CPU device; pilot, truth generation, fits and the held-out evaluation on GPU0 / GPU1 (RTX 5090) under flock /mnt/data/ningan/lab_records/rcs_rl_runner/gpu<N>.lock with >= 4 GB free, labelled SHARED_GPU / EXCLUSIVE_GPU; GPU float atomics make repeated GPU objective calls non-bitwise (byte-wise repeatability is a CPU claim)
common.contact_scope_K2_1: K2 combined review (claude/rl-rubber @60e9119, finding K2-1): law v3 is valid for TRANSLATIONAL sliding only (its patch slip-rate equalisation suppresses rotation about the normal and in-plane bending in slip; label contact_slip_rate_equalised outside that scope). Choice for P2-5: the friction experiments F1 / F2 are scoped to straight-line translational sliding with v3 and the restriction is stated: a free symmetric block (no grip, one contact region = the table plane) pushed by a uniform back-face traction along +x through its symmetry plane, so the motion is pure translation by construction. Law v2 is not used: its only formally scored row is n_t 3 (sliding 0.6), while the fit model is n_t 4 and the truth n_t 6 (v2 NOT_ESTABLISHED there). Scope check (declared, reported in the truth receipts and the held-out predictions): max lateral centroid drift and max change of the y spread of the 9 cross-section centroids <= 1e-4 m (1 video sigma); a row above it is labelled OUTSIDE_TRANSLATIONAL_SCOPE. The fitted mu_table is a translational-sliding friction coefficient of law v3 only; it must not be used for spin, sideways drag or multi-region contact (P2-6 friction stays under the K2-1 fallback). Fit box [0.3, 0.8] and prior box [0.4, 0.6] lie inside the v3 translational envelope at n_t 4 (contact_v3_001) and n_t 6 (contact_envelope_v1_001).

prior_box.draw: rubber_calibration_synthetic.draw_truth: log-uniform for mu_eq, tau1, tau2; uniform for g1, g2, mu_table, density; numpy default_rng(secret seed), secret seed = 128 bits of os.urandom, written only to <run>/sealed/truth.json

measurement.model: measured dimension = nominal + N(0, sigma); measured mass = rho* V_nominal + N(0, sigma); one draw per specimen

sensors.noise: Gaussian N(0, noise_sigma) per sample, then quantisation to the resolution; time stamps exact
sensors.transform: load cell / crosshead / force plate: one sample per control step k = 1..K (the reaction is the control-step mean, the crosshead the step-end position); video: frames f / 240 s, f = 0..floor(T 240), linear interpolation between control-step states; cantilever / sag video = z of the 9 cross-section centroids; friction video = block centroid x (mean of the 9 cross-section centroids)

experiments.held_out_axis: normal load (2 x weight: top traction 1 x nominal weight) and push rate

experiment_definitions.tensile_load_unload: case C (end faces gripped axially, face-centre pins), grip 1 at the crosshead speed eps_dot L: lambda 1 -> max_stretch -> min_stretch (then hold); data: load cell (F = -grip-1 reaction x) and crosshead
experiment_definitions.stress_relaxation: case C, grip 1 linear to hold_stretch in ramp_s, hold for hold_s; load cell + crosshead
experiment_definitions.cantilever_rebound: case A (jaw x <= 0, 2 dx, fully held), body weight and the tip load (-z, last particle layer) ramped together with smootherstep over weight_ramp_s, tip load released at release_s, free rebound for record_after_release_s; video of the 9 cross-section centroids (z)
experiment_definitions.gravity_sag: case A, body weight ramped (smootherstep) over weight_ramp_s and held; video; static observable = mean tip z over static_window_s
experiment_definitions.friction_sliding: free block on the rigid table plane z = 0 (contact law above), weight (+ top traction on the top particle layer) ramped over settle_ramp_s, push traction on the back particle layer rising linearly from push_start_s over push_ramp_s to push_max_over_nominal_normal x (nominal weight + top load), then released (coast); force plate (table reaction x and -z) + video (block centroid x)
experiment_definitions.control_steps: K = ceil(duration / control_dt); a schedule ending inside a step holds its end value; tractions are evaluated at the step's mid time, grip positions are step-end values

objective.residuals: (prediction - data) / sqrt(sigma^2 + resolution^2 / 12) per sample: T / R force (load cell); C / G z of markers 4 and 8, frames f >= 1; F centroid x (frames f >= 1) and the table friction force
objective.split: fit-split experiments of the frozen manifest only; no RL term (a reward argument is refused)
objective.invalid_candidate: every residual of an experiment whose env sets an invalid bit is 1e3

formal_method.name: scipy.optimize.least_squares method trf
formal_method.jacobian: forward differences in u; every residual evaluation runs ONE population of p + 1 = 7 candidates (the point and its 6 perturbations; a perturbation that would leave the box steps backwards) and caches the Jacobian
formal_method.start_design: Latin hypercube, numpy default_rng(seed 2511), over the u-image of the prior box: ln mu_eq [ln 2e5, ln 3.5e5], logit(g1 / 0.5) [logit 0.16, logit 0.4], logit(g2 fraction) [logit(0.06 / 0.42), logit(0.15 / 0.30)], ln tau1 [ln 5e-3, ln 1.5e-2], ln tau2 [ln 6e-2, ln 0.2], mu_table [0.4, 0.6]
formal_method.selection: the start with the lowest cost gives theta_hat
formal_method.lockstep: the 3 starts run in threads; every round evaluates the requests of all active starts as one forward population (rubber_calibration_fit.fit_trf_lockstep; per-start results identical to sequential starts, CPU test); candidates with the same physics-relevant material for an experiment share one env (mu_table acts only in F)

fit.covariance: Gauss-Newton at theta_hat: cov_u = s^2 (J^T J)^-1 with s^2 = chi2 / (n - p) by eigen-decomposition (eigenvalues < 1e-10 x max -> infinite variance), cov_theta = D cov_u D^T (delta method)

comparison_method.name: in-repo CMA-ES (rubber_calibration_fit.CMAES) through the ask / tell hook
comparison_method.status: REPORTED, NOT FORMAL (same population size as one TRF evaluation; 28 candidates; GPU budget)

fit.ask_tell: run_ask_tell(optimizer, objective, space, generations): ask() -> u[lambda, 6], tell(loss[lambda]), loss = |r|^2 / 2; the plug-in point of the external agentic optimizer or a BO method (not run here)

M1.definition: RMSE of the load-cell force over the record / max |F_obs|

M2.definition: relative error of the loop work sum (F_k + F_k-1) / 2 (u_k - u_k-1) over the record (u: prediction the crosshead channel of the prediction, observation the measured crosshead)

M3.definition: relative error of the mean force of the last 10 samples

M4.definition: RMSE of the tip (marker 8) z over frames t >= release_s / (max - min of the observed tip z over the same frames)

M5.definition: absolute error (ms) of the rebound time: tip z smoothed by a centred 5-frame moving average; p0 = value at the release frame, p1 = first local MAXIMUM after release (the tip load acts in -z, so the rebound is upward), p2 = the next local minimum (parabolic refinement); rebound time = first crossing of (p0 + p1) / 2 after release (linear interpolation) - release_s

M6.definition: absolute error of the log decrement 2 ln(|p1 - p0| / |p1 - p2|) (p0, p1, p2 as in M5)

M7_slip.definition: relative error of the slip distance = mean centroid x of the last 5 frames - mean of the 5 frames before push_start_s

M7_onset.definition: absolute error (ms) of the slip onset = first time after push_start_s at which the centroid displacement exceeds 0.5 mm (linear interpolation)

M8.definition: RMS over the control steps 0..K of |volume ratio (mean J) of the prediction - of the noise-free truth|

M9.definition: relative error of the total dissipated energy at the end of the record, D = W_ext - (KE + Psi_eq + Psi_visc_stored) from the books (W_ext: Dirichlet + traction work incl. the weight traction)

metrics.nan: a metric that cannot be extracted (NaN) FAILS

tolerance_rule.formula: tol_mk = max(2 (a_mk + b_mk), floor_m) for every held-out (experiment k, metric m)
tolerance_rule.a_mk: noise floor: the metric between two independent noise realisations (A as the prediction, B as the observation) of the same pilot truth; 0 for M8 / M9 (oracle metrics have no sensor noise)
tolerance_rule.b_mk: discretisation floor: the metric between the NOISE-FREE pilot truth (n_t 6, CFL 0.25; as the observation) and the fit model at theta_pilot with the pilot's measured densities (n_t 4, CFL 0.5; as the prediction)
tolerance_rule.chi2_pilot: reduced chi2 of the fit model at theta_pilot (measured densities) against the pilot's realisation A, fit split, n - p degrees of freedom
tolerance_rule.output: configs/rubber/rubber_calib_thresholds_v1.json, SHA-pinned and committed BEFORE the formal dataset is generated; never changed after it

pilot.seed: its own secret seeds (truth and noise), sealed like the formal dataset; theta_pilot is revealed right after the pilot and used only for the tolerances and chi2_pilot
pilot.realisations: A (the pilot manifest's data) and B (noise floor only)

formal.sealed: artifacts/rl_ready/p2_5/<run>/sealed/truth.json (theta*, rho*, both seeds, noise-free truth channels); only its sha256 and the noise-seed sha256 are in the manifest
formal.sequence: fit (TRF, 3 starts) -> fit receipt -> negative-control fit -> its receipt -> both receipts committed -> one-shot held-out of both -> reveal -> recovery (CAL-06); CMA-ES (reported) any time before the reveal

CAL-01.name: Interface and refusals (CPU)
CAL-01.content: v2 manifest validation (origin, sensors, sealed SHA, origin-bound statuses), split disjointness, path guard, one-shot held-out guard, REAL gate refuses every synthetic manifest (any directory, status, verdict) + gate-directory tripwire, theta bounds vs the step rule, objective refusals (reward, held-out, sealed, v1)
CAL-01.pass: every unit test passes, with CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES='' and with =0

CAL-02.name: Forward-model parity (CPU)
CAL-02.content: population batch = single references byte-wise (L0) for every experiment type (raw summary, visco summary, markers, wrench, work, contact work, plane wrench, every control step), re-used batch and repeated objective calls byte-identical

CAL-03.name: Truth generation receipts
CAL-03.pass: complete: truth profile, generator commit + clean tree, secret seeds never written outside sealed/, sealed SHA and noise-seed SHA in the manifest, manifest + data + oracle frozen (sha256); ordering per CAL-08

CAL-04.name: Fit quality on the fit split (TRF, 3 starts)
CAL-04.pass: chi2_reduced(theta_hat) <= 1.5 x chi2_pilot AND the best start terminated by scipy's xtol / ftol / gtol criterion or by the declared budget max_nfev 40 (status reported)

CAL-05.name: Held-out prediction (primary)
CAL-05.pass: every held-out (experiment, metric) value of the prediction at theta_hat against the frozen held-out data (M8 / M9 against the oracle) <= its frozen tolerance tol_mk

CAL-06.name: Parameter recovery (after the reveal)
CAL-06.pass: |theta_hat_i - theta*_i| <= max(3 sigma_hat_i, 0.02 theta*_i) for every parameter with sigma_hat_i / theta_hat_i < 0.5; the others are reported as non-identifiable

CAL-07.name: Negative control (power)
CAL-07.pass: a fit on T2 + C1 only (same TRF settings and starts) must FAIL CAL-05 on at least one held-out viscous metric (M1, M2, M5 or M6); if it passes, the protocol lacks power and CAL-07 FAILs

CAL-08.name: Order and sealing
CAL-08.pass: protocol commit < pilot run < thresholds commit < formal dataset + manifest freeze (commit) < fit receipt commit < one-shot held-out < reveal, verified from git commit times and the receipts' UTC times; any violation makes the run INVALID

CAL-09.name: Labels
CAL-09.pass: every output carries SIMULATOR_ONLY_UNCALIBRATED and NUMERICAL_VALIDATION_SYNTHETIC; no recipe promoted

real_data.protocol: rubber_calib_tests_real_v1 (to be declared when real data exist): the same pipeline with data_origin real_measurement, tolerances from the measurement error plus a pilot on fit data only, the manifest FROZEN_FOR_HELDOUT before any held-out evaluation, an additional Prony term with a declared short tau (ADR 0023 §22.10; fitted or reported as non-identifiable); only a held-out PASS through rubber_calibration_v2.real_calibrated_gate_v2 can make a recipe REAL_CALIBRATED

deviations_from_plan: Tensile width 12 mm (plan 10 mm): on the particle lattice of n_t 4 / 6 at t 3 and 4 mm with the face-centre pins on grid nodes.

Cantilever 42 x 15 mm, held-out length 51 mm (plan 80 x 16 mm and 120 mm): lattice (multiples of 3 mm serve t 3 / 4 mm at n_t 4 / 6) and frequency (a flat 80 x 16 x 4 mm strip has f1 ~ 3 Hz and a ~49 mm linear gravity sag, so 0.4 s of video would not hold three tip peaks; 42 mm gives ~10 Hz, 51 mm ~7 Hz). Design probe (fit model, prior-box points, GPU, not a result): a 63 mm strip was still swinging from a 0.15 s weight ramp at release (first extremum downwards), hence 51 mm and a 0.30 s ramp. Held-out initial deformation = 2 x tip load.

Initial deformation and gravity sag by a simulated, declared load phase (smootherstep ramp 0.30 s, hold to 0.40 s, tip load released) instead of the static initializer: relax_to_static is single-env only and has no relaxed Prony-state initialisation; the population batch cannot run it.

Friction rig: force-controlled push (back-face traction ramp to 0.85 x normal load, then released) instead of a speed-controlled fixture pusher: slip distance and onset then depend on mu (a speed-controlled push makes the slip distance kinematic), and there is no contact frame (no per-node frame slerp). F2 holds out the normal load (top traction 1 x nominal weight, i.e. 2 x weight) and the push rate (0.15 s instead of 0.20 s ramp) instead of '20 mm/s'.

Tensile unloading to lambda 1.1 (plan: back to 1): keeps the strip in tension (a thin strip in compression buckles and truth and fit could bifurcate differently); a 1D Prony design check over the prior box gives a minimum unloading force >= 9 % of the maximum at eps_dot 1-20 /s.

M5 uses the midpoint between the release value and the first rebound peak as the equilibrium estimate (the static equilibrium is not observable within the record); M7 onset threshold 0.5 mm (5 video sigma) with a declared floor of 2 ms (the plan gives only the 2 % slip floor); M8 is the RMS over the record.
Gravity applied as a ramped body traction with solver gravity 0 (quasi-static loading; the step load of a constant gravity overshoots by 2).
Friction law and scope per the K2 review (K2-1): v3 for translational sliding only (see common.contact_scope_K2_1); v2 has no formal row at n_t 4 / 6.
CMA-ES comparison budget 4 generations x 7 (GPU budget); reported, not formal.
